theme: App layers for data: data layer, service layer and the repository pattern

terms.definition: The part of an app that loads and saves data, away from the screens.

video.description:
Learn to explain layers that load and save data: Data Layer, Service Layer & Repository Pattern, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Data Layer - The part of an app that loads and saves data, away from the screens.
Service Layer - The part of an app that offers actions like login or search to the rest of the code.
Repository Pattern - A pattern that hides where data comes from behind one simple interface.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.title: iOS Data Layer, Service Layer & Repository Pattern | Day 195
landscape.description:
Explain Data Layer, Service Layer & Repository Pattern in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
Data Layer, Service Layer, Repository Pattern 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Data Layer - The part of an app that loads and saves data, away from the screens.
한국어: Data Layer: 화면과 떨어져 데이터를 불러오고 저장하는 앱의 부분

Service Layer - The part of an app that offers actions like login or search to the rest of the code.
한국어: Service Layer: 로그인이나 검색 같은 동작을 앱의 나머지 코드에 제공하는 부분

Repository Pattern - A pattern that hides where data comes from behind one simple interface.
한국어: Repository Pattern: 데이터의 출처를 하나의 간단한 인터페이스 뒤에 숨기는 패턴

In this video, Mina and Jake talk about layers that load and save data, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.
Mina와 Jake의 채팅 스타일 대화와 화면 속 Swift 코드로 배워요.

landscape.hook: Can you explain Data Layer, Service Layer and Repository Pattern in English?

dialogue.title: Who talks to the database?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, the view model calls the network and the database directly.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Move that work to a data layer. It loads and saves data away from the screens.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And what is a service layer?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A service layer offers actions like login or search to the rest of the app.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So the data layer keeps things, and the service layer does things?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Good way to say it. Now add the repository pattern. A repository hides where the data comes from.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Like `Repo` in our code, where `Web` gives the `name`?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. The view model asks the `Repo` for `name` and does not care about the source.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So with the repository pattern I can swap web data for a test value?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Exactly. That is why the repository pattern is so popular.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I will build a data layer and a service layer for login.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Nice, and use the repository pattern for the user profile.
The data layer reads the user list from disk.
